info.title: Yo'l-Yo'lakay Driver API
info.description:
Yo'l-Yo'lakay haydovchi ilovasi uchun backend API (TZ: BACKEND_TZ_DRIVER.md).

**Autentifikatsiya.** `POST /auth/driver/send-otp` → `POST /auth/driver/verify-otp` → `tokens.access_token`
har bir so'rovda `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` sarlavhasida yuboriladi (24 soat). Muddati tugasa
`POST /auth/refresh` ga `refresh_token` yuboriladi — yangi juftlik qaytadi, eskisi bekor bo'ladi.

**Javob formati.** Har doim `{ "success", "message", "data", "error" }`. Xatolikda `error.code` — mashina
o'qiydigan kod (`VALIDATION_ERROR`, `UNAUTHENTICATED`, `DRIVER_NOT_APPROVED`, `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE`,
`ORDER_NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE`, ...), `error.details` — `[{field, message}]`.

**Vaqt** ISO 8601 UTC, **pul** so'mda butun son, **ID** lar UUID.

**WebSocket (Reverb, Pusher protokoli).** `wss://<host>/app/<REVERB_APP_KEY>`, kanal `private-driver.{driver_id}`,
avtorizatsiya: `POST /broadcasting/auth` (Bearer token bilan). Server hodisalari: `NEW_TAXI_ORDER_OFFER`,
`BOOKING_UPDATE`, `ORDER_CANCELLED_BY_PASSENGER`. GPS: `client-DRIVER_LOCATION_UPDATE` hodisasi shu kanalga.
